headline: Man City guilty of all charges of Premier League financial breaches
description: Manchester City have been found guilty of all 115 charges of serious breaches of Premier League regulations, the Premier League confirmed in a 1,545-word statement on Tuesday.

headline: Cole Palmer's England withdrawal a product of 'sick' system - PFA chief
description: Cole Palmer's recent England withdrawal is the product of a "sick" system that is demanding too much of the game's stars, according to Professional Footballers' Association chief executive Maheta Molango.

headline: Man City learned of guilty verdicts in summer before transfer activity - sources
description: Manchester City were first informed that they had been found guilty of more than 100 breaches of the Premier League's financial rules in the summer, sources told ESPN, before spending heavily in the transfer market.
